stages.activity: Author a graph-shaped workflow description (nodes, edges, intended routing).
stages.control: Governed by an admitted SPEC mission contract (parent L2 section 2); not a standalone artifact.

stages.activity: Translate the conceptual plan into the provider-neutral workflow contract, using vendor vocabulary as naming reference only.
stages.control: Independent schema/contract review before any code is written.

stages.activity: Move the contract and any implementation PR through the existing transfer bus / PR handoff router.
stages.control: The repository's PR-body handoff template; no GE-specific bypass.

stages.activity: Deterministic and policy gates: scope, budget, worker independence, approved tool/model class.
stages.control: Parent L2 section 3.6 Gate Engine; SPEC authority envelope.

stages.activity: Exact-head, session-independent review of the implementation and of graph behavior under test.
stages.control: mission_state.py invariant: REVIEW_REQUESTED != REVIEW_COMPLETED; a builder's own adversarial self-check is never independent review.

stages.activity: Human approval at every consequential boundary (merge, activation, capital/production reliance).
stages.control: Parent L1 Constitutional Invariant 9; cannot be satisfied by any node's own output.

stages.activity: Every node's evidence (claims, artifacts, tests, exceptions) recorded in the Evidence Bus and bound to EPAP/PAP.
Retry/fallback/escalation policy per node, with explicit max attempts and budget ceilings.
stages.control: Parent L2 sections 3.7-3.8; no unbounded agent persistence.

stages.activity: Graph run state persists independently of any one chat session or worker process, and survives restart without duplicated execution.
stages.control: Parent L2 sections 3.2 and 3.10; the governance persistence contract governs regardless of engine; a vendor checkpointing feature is a reference pattern only.

stages.activity: Trajectory- and outcome-level evaluation of graph runs before any reliance claim.
stages.control: Vendor evaluation vocabulary as reference; governance acceptance thresholds are a future L2/implementation decision.

stages.activity: Identity/authorization, guardrails, sandboxed execution, network perimeter.
stages.control: Six-ring security doctrine (PARALLEL-6-RING-SECURITY-IMPLEMENTATION-STACKED-001 and addenda), controlling.

stages.activity: Runtime/environment selection for any eventually-approved engine.
stages.control: Separate HITL-gated activation decision; no activation is granted by a contract.

stages.activity: Trace/log every node execution, gate evaluation and state transition.
stages.control: Parent L2 section 3.10 and existing governance observability doctrine; vendor telemetry integration is a reference pattern, not an adopted dependency.

stages.activity: Operator-visible projection of actual graph/node runtime state.
stages.control: Extend L1-L1-L4-WORKFLOW-OPERATOR-DASHBOARD-001; the dashboard shows where work stands, it does not decide where work moves.
